panels.title: Backends up
panels.description:
Number of backends (regional data nodes) that answered the hub's last `get_meta` probe within 3 s.

**Means:** should equal the number of backends in `registry.json`. Lower = some region's map is currently missing from the hub.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Backends down
panels.description:
Number of backends whose last probe failed (timeout after 3 s, HTTP error, or unreachable).

**Means:** anything above 0 means visitors on the hub see that region as offline (dashed ring, no playgrounds).

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Playgrounds (all backends)
panels.description:
Sum of all playgrounds across every backend, as reported by each backend's `get_meta`.

**Means:** overall size of the federated map. A sudden drop usually means a backend is down or mid-import, not that playgrounds disappeared.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Hub poll age
panels.description:
Seconds since each hub last wrote its `/metrics` file (`time() - spielplatz_poll_generated_timestamp`).

**Means:** for the production hub this should stay below ~120 s. Much higher = the hub's poll cron has died and every other panel shows frozen data.

On a standalone stack this grows forever: it only writes a placeholder once at startup.

panels.title: Up per backend
panels.description:
Per backend over time: up (1) or down (0) for each poll.

**Means:** gaps or red stretches show outages and when they happened. Short single blips are usually a slow response over the 3 s timeout.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: get_meta latency
panels.description:
Round-trip time of the hub's last `get_meta` call to each backend, measured from the hub server (not from visitors' browsers).

**Means:** a rough health/load signal per backend. Rising latency often precedes timeouts; spikes are typical while a backend imports. Shows 0 when the probe failed.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Import age
panels.description:
Seconds since each backend last finished an OSM data import (`last_import_at`).

**Means:** how stale a region's playground data is compared to OpenStreetMap. The importer daemon re-imports every 6–8 days by default (`REIMPORT_INTERVAL_MIN/MAX_DAYS`), so the line saws up to ~8 days and drops back. Clearly more than the configured max (default ~9 days) suggests the daemon is stuck or disabled. Missing line = backend down or never imported.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Detailed share (complete / total)
panels.description:
Share of each backend's playgrounds that are **detailed** (complete ÷ total).

**Means:** how well a region is mapped. Low values show where mappers could help.

**Mapping detail** says how much of a playground is mapped in OSM, not how good it is:
- **Detailed** (`complete`): has play equipment (any `playground=*` object, or a soccer/basketball/table-tennis pitch) **and** info (`opening_hours`, `surface` or a meaningful `access`).
- **Basic** (`partial`): one of the two.
- **No details yet** (`missing`): neither.

Benches, shelters and picnic tables don't count as equipment; photos don't count either.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Importing
panels.description:
Per backend over time: 1 while osm2pgsql is importing data on that backend, otherwise 0.

**Means:** during an import counts and latency may jump and the hub shows the region as "updating". Explains dips in other panels. Normally a window every 6–8 days per backend, staggered so they don't all import at once.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Playgrounds per backend by mapping detail
panels.description:
Each backend's playgrounds split into **detailed / basic / no details yet**, stacked, sorted by total.

**Means:** bar length = region size; green share = how well it is mapped. Compare regions at a glance; hover for exact numbers.

**Mapping detail** says how much of a playground is mapped in OSM, not how good it is:
- **Detailed** (`complete`): has play equipment (any `playground=*` object, or a soccer/basketball/table-tennis pitch) **and** info (`opening_hours`, `surface` or a meaningful `access`).
- **Basic** (`partial`): one of the two.
- **No details yet** (`missing`): neither.

Benches, shelters and picnic tables don't count as equipment; photos don't count either.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: Counts per backend
panels.description:
The same per-backend numbers as a table: total, the three mapping-detail counts, and the detailed and basic shares (count ÷ total).

**Means:** exact values for comparison or copying; click a column header to sort (e.g. by *Detailed share* to find the best-mapped region).

**Mapping detail** says how much of a playground is mapped in OSM, not how good it is:
- **Detailed** (`complete`): has play equipment (any `playground=*` object, or a soccer/basketball/table-tennis pitch) **and** info (`opening_hours`, `surface` or a meaningful `access`).
- **Basic** (`partial`): one of the two.
- **No details yet** (`missing`): neither.

Benches, shelters and picnic tables don't count as equipment; photos don't count either.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: All backends by mapping detail
panels.description:
Totals across all backends: all playgrounds and how many are detailed, basic or have no details yet.

**Means:** the federation-wide mapping picture. Detailed + Basic + No details yet = Total.

**Mapping detail** says how much of a playground is mapped in OSM, not how good it is:
- **Detailed** (`complete`): has play equipment (any `playground=*` object, or a soccer/basketball/table-tennis pitch) **and** info (`opening_hours`, `surface` or a meaningful `access`).
- **Basic** (`partial`): one of the two.
- **No details yet** (`missing`): neither.

Benches, shelters and picnic tables don't count as equipment; photos don't count either.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.

panels.title: OSM data age
panels.description:
Seconds since the OpenStreetMap snapshot each backend serves was taken (the PBF extract's replication timestamp), not since the import ran.

**Means:** how old the playground data really is from a visitor's point of view. It is always at least *Import age*: an import of a day-old Geofabrik extract starts at ~1 day. A gap between the two that keeps growing means imports run but fetch an old extract (stale `PBF_URL` mirror). Missing line = backend predates the field, or no import yet.

**Source:** the hub's `/metrics`, written by `poll-federation.sh`. The hub polls each backend's `get_meta` every 60 s from its own server; Prometheus scrapes the hub every 60 s.
